task:
Analyze user-flow completeness and edge cases for a planned improvement pass over the experimental QML front-end of a Qt6.7 desktop app (src/app/experimental/).
The app: main.qml (~700 lines) = toolbar (calibration/images/models buttons + interaction-mode toggle + dialog openers),
left panel (frame ListView + model ListView with delegate selection + ML strip with .pt pickers/segment/estimate buttons),
center QmlVtkRenderer viewport, bottom run bar (Run/Stop + progress).
Dialogs: FileDialogs (calibration/images/models/.pt/pose/kinematics), replace-dataset confirm, message dialog,
settings Dialog (SettingsPanel.qml form), poses Dialog (PoseCell.qml table, Repeater over all frames, 6 editable cells/row,
dirty badge, copy-prev/next, save/load). Bridges (C++ QObjects exposed as context properties) hold all logic; QML is thin glue.
Planned changes: extract main.qml panels into component files; property injection for testability;
Theme token/typography compliance; keyboard nav + accessibility; pose-table virtualization (Repeater -> ListView);
PoseCell binding-fix; Qt Quick Test coverage; qmlprofiler pass.
Identify: (1) state-transition gaps in the view layer (e.g. dialogs open during optimizer run, dialog interplay,
run-state + dialog openers, empty states), (2) edge cases the new component extraction could break
(id/scope references, anchors, Qt.callLater timing, Connections targets),
(3) user-flow completeness gaps worth covering in tests (load flow ordering, ML degradation, pose edit validation, replace-dataset confirm),
(4) handoff gaps between QML view and bridge signals.
Report concrete findings with file/line references where possible; keep it tight and actionable.

validationOutput: Cross-checked every claimed gap against bridge implementations: (1) optimizer persists storage with no table refresh (OptimizerBridge.cpp:322-324, PoseBridge refresh paths only on mutation/selection/dataset), (2) applyViewerPose emits viewerPoseApplied without table refresh, (3) ML seed cleared only on selectionChanged (MlBridge.cpp:99-103) and stale-guarded only on frame/model change, (4) Estimate button enablement omits hasSegmentModel (main.qml:808-813 vs MlBridge.cpp:264-271), (5) Black sil./Fem-Tib lack run-lock bindings (main.qml:820, 836-850), (6) storage access is GUI-thread-only, so drag-during-run is a semantic clobber, not a memory race.
residualRisks: Stale-pose-table premise (I1/I2) rests on Qt Quick Controls Dialog content persisting across open/close and editingFinished firing on delegate destruction/recycling (C1/C2) — standard QQC2 behavior, but confirm empirically in the test harness before implementing the fix.
Seed-vs-drag interplay (I3) depends on controller takeSeedForRun semantics read from headers, not from the controller source, which was outside the reviewed surface.
Analysis is text-grounded; no runtime/QML scene was executed to observe the flows.

important: MlBridge.cpp:99-103 - pending ML seed survives a same-frame manual drag; next run silently overrides the user arrangement (I3)

childReport.manualNotes: Report contains 5 user flows, 2 critical / 6 important / 6 minor gaps, 10 prioritized questions, and 5 next steps. The two critical items are about the PLANNED virtualization change, not current behavior — they must be decided before the Repeater->ListView unit. Bridge-level unit tests are already strong (pose validation, ML degradation, gate, seed staleness); the Qt Quick Test layer is entirely absent and should pin the view-level flows listed in step 4.
